truths.CP2:
SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM order_lines AS ol
JOIN products AS p ON p.product_id = ol.product_id
WHERE ol.unit_price_eur > 10 * p.unit_cost_eur
truths.CP4:
SELECT ROUND(COALESCE(SUM((ol.quantity * ol.unit_price_eur - ol.line_discount_eur)
                           - (ol.quantity * ol.unit_price_eur / 100 - ol.line_discount_eur)), 0), 2)
FROM order_lines AS ol
JOIN products AS p ON p.product_id = ol.product_id
WHERE ol.unit_price_eur > 10 * p.unit_cost_eur
